  "numeric_solution": false,
  "boundary_cases": true,
  "passage_integrity": true,
  "passage_answerability": true,
  "meaningfully_distinct": true,
  "evidence_ids": [
    "E1.1",
    "E1.2"
  ],
  "reasons": [
    "The total premium is 100 × Rs 2 = Rs 200, and the stem says it was fully received. E1.1 says received premium is not debited on forfeiture.",
    "The missed first call leads to forfeiture; it does not make the already received premium unpaid."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Share Capital",
  "syllabus_topic": "Forfeiture of shares issued at a premium; treatment of Securities Premium Reserve",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "The shares were issued at a premium of Rs 2 per share.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "The premium on the shares forfeited was fully received with allotment money.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "The shares were forfeited following non-payment of the first call.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": false,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "If the Rs 200 premium had remained unpaid, debiting the unpaid premium at forfeiture could fit the rule; the stem says it was fully received.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "If only Rs 100 of premium remained unpaid, a Rs 100 premium debit might apply; the stem expressly says the premium was fully received.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "Treat forfeiture as cancelling the paid premium and refunding Rs 200; this refund treatment is not supported by the supplied rule.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "strained",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],
  "cuet_fit": {
    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Tests the syllabus-named treatment of forfeiture of shares."
      },
      "format_authenticity": {
        "level": 2,
        "evidence": "A valid four-option, single-answer case-application MCQ; no authenticated comparator was supplied."
      },
      "level_calibration": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "One-step application of a core Class XII share-capital rule; no authenticated comparator was supplied."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 2,
        "evidence": "Options distinguish received premium from unpaid premium, though the refund distractor is less plausible."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 1,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "application",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": []
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "It is debited with Rs 200",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "the securities premium account is not to be debited at the time of forfeiture if the premium has been received in respect of the forefeited shares",
      "reason": "The premium was received, so the reserve is not debited; the option's asserted Rs 200 debit is false."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "It is debited with Rs 100",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "the securities premium account is not to be debited at the time of forfeiture if the premium has been received in respect of the forefeited shares",
      "reason": "The entire premium was received, so no part of it is debited from the reserve."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "It is debited with Rs 200",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "the securities premium account is not to be debited at the time of forfeiture if the premium has been received in respect of the forefeited shares",
      "reason": "The source rules out the debit; the option's additional refund assertion is also not the stated treatment."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "the securities premium account is not to be debited at the time of forfeiture if the premium has been received in respect of the forefeited shares and the amount of forfeiture shall be excluding premium amount.",
      "reason": "This matches the stated condition and treatment: received premium is not debited and is excluded from forfeiture amount."
    }
  ]
}
